newsitem.title: USA: American Homestar buys mobile home retailer.
newsitem.headline: American Homestar buys mobile home retailer.

text.p: American Homestar Corp said it bought N.C. Mobile Home Corp, a mobile home retailer based in North Carolina.

The company said the total purchase price will be determined after August, and will be based on certain performance targets. It said it expects to pay up to $2.5 million in cash and notes and up to 117,647 shares of American Homestar for N.C. Mobile Home.
The transaction is expected to be slightly accretive to fiscal 1998 earnings, the company said.
